decision: stopped at the first blocked preflight and repaired the checkout before implementation
why: the repository requires a current branch, live duplicate check, Node 24, and complete dependencies before expensive work
no open pull request implements issue 6507 and the delegated task requires an independent branch
evidence: live issue 6507 and duplicate PR query

decision: kept indicator contribution arithmetic inside the scorer and the full-imputation factor at the dimension-to-domain boundary
why: weightedBlend determines indicator contributions while coverageWeightedMean applies the 0.5 factor only after the dimension score exists

decision: selected request-local scorer tracing with provider-specific raw observation policy
why: literal scorer arithmetic is reproducible while post-hoc projection can reconcile totals without matching the executed formula
result: trace owns normalized scores and contributions; policy owns raw release and provenance

decision: split implementation into disjoint scorer-trace, source-policy, and API-contract units
why: the seams can be proved independently and avoid concurrent edits to generated artifacts
result: parent retained handler integration, generation, commits, PR delivery, review, and CI

decision: exposed the retired reserve-adequacy dimension as inactive and reconciliation-unavailable instead of inventing a contribution
why: the scorer intentionally returns a neutral display score with zero coverage and zero executed indicator contribution
evidence: focused RPC test first failed on the retired placeholder
result: contract now reports active=false with a reason and keeps all contributions at zero

decision: regenerated sebuf clients servers request validation OpenAPI and public MCP facts after the final contract change
why: generated artifacts must match the source proto and registered MCP tool
result: focused contract suite and 499-test parity suite passed

decision: cached derived trace allocations per dimension and removed avoidable trace-path object copies
why: the private API always emits 72 rows while the public score path must not pay trace-only allocation costs
result: 84 focused tests plus npm run typecheck and npm run typecheck:api passed

decision: required a reviewed API or dataset path and marked exact observation provenance separately from registry attribution
why: a provider host or descriptive source link does not prove that the reviewed dataset produced the selected observation
result: World Bank raw release now requires api.worldbank.org/v2 provenance; documentation and terms URLs fail closed

decision: left retrievedAt unavailable on every row
why: the scorer preserves provider observation time or source year but not a per-indicator seed retrieval time
result: response dataVersion is not misreported as per-indicator retrieval time

decision: kept fallback contributions included when a dimension is marked source-failure
why: the scorer publishes the substituted score and the drill-down must reconcile to that exact score
result: source-failure remains a provenance state without erasing executed contributions

decision: resolved source attribution and observation provenance per exact contributing source
why: aggregate indicator policy metadata can mislabel Eurostat or an unused composite dependency
result: missing or unused sources are registry attribution only and Eurostat stays audit-incomplete

decision: used the oldest constituent year for composite observation age
why: a recent source must not hide an older input that contributed to the score
result: energy and liquid-reserve composite ages are conservative

decision: added a five-minute versioned response cache strict diagnostic seed reads and a fail-closed 60-per-minute route budget
why: a cold build fans out across 62 source keys and Redis errors must not look like valid missing observations
result: repeated builds coalesce while source-read and limiter failures fail closed

decision: corrected energy-v2 provenance and failed closed on low-carbon raw redistribution
why: the fossil-electricity seed is World Bank WDI while the low-carbon OWID chart contains Ember and Energy Institute upstream data
result: imported-fossil provenance now names World Bank and low-carbon raw values remain audit-incomplete

decision: narrowed World Bank raw release to exact indicator paths and required an exact observation-level seed timestamp
why: a provider-wide API root can match unrelated data and an extraction date from another seed is false provenance
result: static rows trace country seededAt or _recovered.seededAt; other otherwise licensable rows fail closed until their own seed time is traced

decision: disabled JMESPath for the attribution-bound response and traced only actual WGI contributors with the oldest source year
why: projection can separate a raw value from required attribution and a composite must not hide an older input
result: MCP and OpenAPI discovery omit projection; both runtimes reject it; WGI continuity exposes raw data only with complete exact provenance and conservative age
